scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('backend/.env'))fs.copyFileSync('backend/.env.example','backend/.env')"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
